scope: 87-configuration archived Cu K-edge cohort; raw inputs/logs audited read-only

main_decks.recorded_controls: SCF, Green, Perdew; no explicit SCFexc, Screening, nohole, or Gamma_hole keyword

interpretation: Version banners identify FDMNES revision 28 July 2026 in the available outputs. The 332 surviving convolution logs report Gamma_hole=1.55 eV and Gamma_max=10 eV. In that revision the guide says K-edge self-consistency is by default done without a core hole, with core-hole plus screening charge added at the XANES step; because these inputs request SCF but omit SCFexc/Screening/nohole, the primary cohort follows that default treatment. The 16 remaining layer spectra lack a separate convolution output log, although every layer directory has a FDMNES revision banner. The ISAAC core_hole_treatment field remains not_reported; inferred settings are supported by final decks/output logs, not that metadata field.
